claim: P70: separate structural acceptance, approximation control and sequential rejection
coverage_method: Compositional correspondence for a prose conjunction of P62-P69 implications, plus new substantive composition bridges. No new monolithic theorem is claimed that silently unifies different reference measures or identifies unrelated model representations.
review_kind: Author self-review of new TransferLearningCertificate module, with raw-source inspection of exact component signatures. Root cumulative compiler/replay is separate.

dependency_graph.clause: Structural internal all-horizon validity from exact quadratic certificate; successful discovery is sufficient, not necessary.
dependency_graph.assumptions: Literal finite SOS/Gram/coefficient/moment PolynomialCertificate, positive definite H, and normalized initial state. Discovery route separately needs exact ratio/fixed-center/invariant-space/rank-one nonzero-mass hypotheses.
dependency_graph.result: Actual nonnegative word densities, probability record laws at every finite horizon and prefix consistency. Discovery conclusion is not supplied as a premise and is never treated as necessary for all valid models.

dependency_graph.clause: Common-domain Lipschitz approximation and finite coefficient budgets give fixed-horizon upper law control.
dependency_graph.assumptions: Actual generating DensityInstrument D on one declared cone/reference, nonnegative Lipschitz constant with induced-norm inequality over whole interval, positive fitted coefficient maps T with exact integrated average mass, and literal base-norm coefficient-error inequalities. Same actual common policy and initial normalized state.
dependency_graph.result: TV of actual full joint action-and-observation laws <=min(1,T/2*(L/sqrt(3(n+2))+maximumCoefficientError)). Positive coefficient budgets are derived from actual error inequalities, not assumed independently.
dependency_graph.separation: D and fittedInstrument(C,n,T) share the same literal cone/reference. This theorem does not silently identify the [-1,1] P62 coordinates/reference with the [0,1] Bernstein reference. Supplied measured recodings, when used, must be checked separately.

dependency_graph.clause: An outside-representation process uses separately justified conditional-kernel error.
dependency_graph.assumptions: Actual causal Markov observation kernels on standard Borel observations with common measurable policy, complete kernel values on every needed history, actual initial history law, and independently justified conditional discrepancy budget.
dependency_graph.result: Full record-law TV <=min(1,sum expected-under-P conditional TVs), with actual initial-law TV if initial laws differ. No common latent state or fitted-model membership is inferred.

dependency_graph.clause: Actual predictable observations give simultaneous lower discrepancy certificates, including selected positive times.
dependency_graph.assumptions: Actual adapted unit-bounded observations and their actual CEs, countable prospective registered tests/budgets, probability true/proposed observation laws, measurable bounded tests and AE identity equating true test means with the actual CEs.
dependency_graph.result: Existence of one measurable event with probability >=1-delta on which every registered rule and every positive finite time satisfies P68 actual-law lower certificate. Any data-selected rule and positive finite time is a direct specialization of the universal pathwise conclusion.
dependency_graph.ae_handling: refine_event_ae encloses the exceptional set in an actual measurable null superset and subtracts it from the measurable P66 event. It preserves probability exactly without a measurability assumption on an arbitrary target predicate.

dependency_graph.clause: Covered randomized actions give contextual evidence.
dependency_graph.assumptions: Actual recorded randomized action/observation Experiment identity, predictable measurable bounded test, positive known propensity coverage and prospective budgets.
dependency_graph.result: Actual weighted test sums estimate the true action-kernel means along encountered contexts with the full P66 boundary divided by coverage. No reset-population or new-policy occupancy inference.

new_module_development_check.imports: Hash-matching old .19 project artifacts used solely for development. Root performs fresh cumulative source compilation, axiom audit, replay and controls.

obligation_matrix.item: P62 literal certificate -> all-horizon actual-law validity
P63 proposal is a sufficient construction, not necessary model-class assumption
P64-P65 actual common-domain hypotheses -> actual full-law upper budget
P69 outside-representation alternative retains separate true-history kernel-budget assumptions
P66 -> P68 actual-law simultaneous lower probability event with AE mean identities
Selected positive finite time/rule is specialization of same simultaneous event

No inference from structural validity or test nonrejection to generating model membership or upper accuracy

decisive_evidence: Every new theorem invokes proved component endpoints with actual raw mathematical hypotheses. Desired component conclusions are not supplied as premises.

common_domain_upper_law constructs the fitted instrument from positive coefficient maps and exact mass and derives the integrated error from the Lipschitz/coefficient premises before invoking the full continuous-record law comparison.

simultaneous_lower_evidence starts from the full arbitrary-space P66 theorem and uses the actual CE/true-law identity, not an assumed confidence event. Measurable null-cover refinement puts all identities on the same returned measurable high-probability event.

SequentialLowerCertificate.zero_test_misses_disjoint_laws provides an exact existing boundary example: zero test residual can coexist with maximal TV, so nonrejection is not used as an upper guarantee.
strongest_safe_statement: The five separate P70 implications have full component correspondences under their written mathematical hypotheses. The common-domain and sequential conjunction bridges are explicitly formalized. No empirical adequacy, unrestricted model membership or untested upper accuracy claim is added.
